name: Vincent van Gogh
findings: Within his own canvases, windsor tan turns up as a small accent in 100% of the paintings that hold it, 1.9x the archive's rate (from 1239 paintings here).
Within his own canvases, maize turns up as the lightest note in 100% of the paintings that hold it, 2.5x the archive's rate (from 1239 paintings here).
Within his own canvases, brazil red turns up as the shadow in 50% of the paintings that hold it, 4.8x the archive's rate (from 1239 paintings here).
Rarely uses smoky black, common in the same museum(s)' other paintings (from 1239 paintings here).
Rarely uses dark olive brown, common in the same museum(s)' other paintings (from 1239 paintings here).
Pairs cinereous with silver pink more than chance would predict (3 of 1239 paintings here).
Pairs black coral with dark blue slate more than chance would predict (3 of 1239 paintings here).
His single largest palette family (smoky black, dark jungle green, black olive) covers 51% of his paintings here.
